A real registration/identity/cache fixture reproduces the 45-of-46 roster failure before the fix and validates 46 regular cities plus four Strongholds afterward without loading that map's definition. Cover existing incomplete descriptors, bounded city ordinals, realm/shard isolation, duplicates, missing records, stale expansion replies and off-map upgrade lookup. Execute an actual Retry click after descriptor repair at desktop, landscape-mobile, portrait and short-landscape sizes; require one read, cleared warning, complete holdings and preserved scroll. Existing roster/list tests protect ownership invalidation, reconnect/error/timeout isolation, ordering, upgrade reconciliation, navigation and touch scrolling. Realm-refresh and Core-release suites cover the shared descriptor-registration dependency and current topology; build/artifact/asset validation covers delivery. This is client metadata only: no server-authoritative rule, data, query, migration or installed backend change, so emulator suites are not applicable.
